test_cases_present: partial - the spec defines the command encoding, mode-register fields, state machine, clocking architecture, and AC timing that map directly to compliance scenarios; JEDEC and DRAM vendors maintain separate normative compliance procedures (LPDDR5 PHY signoff suites) out of scope of this physical-layer standard.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Power-up + initialization: supply ramp ordering (VDD1/VDD2H/VDD2L/VDDQ=0.5 V) + RESET_n deassert + CK start + mode-register program + ZQ calibration + initial WCK2CK synchronization → device ready.
RESET_n assertion (active-low) and re-initialization.
Quarter-speed CK + 7-bit DDR CA command framing: verify a command occupies two CA transfers (rising + falling CK) and CS marks the first cycle.
WCK2CK synchronization: WS_FS (free-start, multiple following accesses), WS_RD (read-optimized), WS_WR (write-optimized) issued via CAS; verify internal WCK locks to CK before the transfer.
Activate sequence: ACT-1 then ACT-2 to open a row; verify tRCD before first column command.
Read: CAS(WS_RD) → RD / RD32 at programmed RL; DRAM drives RDQS edge-aligned with DQ; BL16 and BL32; RD32 starting position via C0/B3.
Write: CAS(WS_WR) → WR / WR32 / MWR at programmed WL; controller drives WCK; DRAM samples DQ + DMI on both WCK edges; verify Set A / Set B WL.
Write-X (WRX): verify burst filled with all-zeros (WXS=0) / all-ones (WXS=1) without transferring data.
Masked Write (MWR): verify DMI used as per-byte data mask.
Bank-group timing: tCCD_L / tRRD_L same-group vs tCCD_S / tRRD_S different-group; tFAW four-activate window.
Refresh: REFab (all-bank, tRFCab) and REFpb (per-bank round-robin, tRFCpb); verify other-bank access during per-bank refresh; tREFI per temperature range.
RFM / Adaptive Refresh Management (JESD209-5B) coverage for Rowhammer reliability.
Self-refresh entry/exit via CA command (no CKE); verify low-power entry lasts until CS next goes high.
Deep Sleep Mode (DSE): entry via SRE; verify full re-initialization required on exit.
DVFS / DVFSC: frequency-set-point switch; WCK rate change; RL/WL/ODT/Vref retraining; VDD2H/VDD2L core voltage scaling.
Link ECC: Read Link ECC and Write Link ECC single-bit correction on the wire; verify configuration consistency.
DBI (Data Bus Inversion) on DMI: verify reduced number of driven bits.
Mode register access: MRW (two CA cycles, MA[6:0] + OP[7:0]) and MRR; verify tMRW / tMRD / tMRR.
ZQ calibration: start/latch via MPC against external reference resistor.
Read training: RDCAL fixed pattern / Read FIFO; DQ + RDQS sampling-phase sweep with DFE.
Write training: Write FIFO; WCK write-eye training.
CA-bus timing (setup/hold to CK at double data rate) and DQ timing (setup/hold to WCK).
Differential CK / WCK / RDQS swing and crossing-point verification.
Low-voltage IO compliance at VDDQ = 0.5 V; Vref(ca)/Vref(dq) per frequency set point.
IDD measurement across the defined per-state current points (active / standby / power-down / self-refresh / deep-sleep).
